findings.trigger: Open Exported, go back to Tailored, tap Export PDF again (or recreate after process death): init re-runs exportResume, which rewrites the PDF and appends another ExportRecord with the same file name and bumps updatedAt each time, so the history and the account data archive list the same export several times.
findings.title: Export runs in ViewModel init and appends a new ExportRecord on every entry

findings.trigger: A new export deletes every file in cache/exports before writing; if the render or rename then fails, the previous application's PDF is already gone and its stored exportFileName points at a missing file (Open then shows Couldn't find the PDF). Delete after the rename succeeds, and only files other than the new target.
findings.title: Previous exports are deleted before the new file is written

findings.rule: 279-c4 text extracted equals the accepted document (test strength)
findings.trigger: renderedLinesEqualAcceptedDocument compares composer.lines, which the composer fills from its input before drawing, to a list built from the same document; text that fails to draw or is clipped would still pass. Accepted by D65 until the D44 walk extracts the PDF text, but a follow-up instrumented test is needed.
findings.title: Line equality test records input text, not drawn text
